quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #21
										  					
  

18 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means the vehicle:
questions.explanation: An orange triangle is displayed on the back of farm tractors and horse-drawn vehicles that travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: A single broken white line down the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. You can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. You can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. Dashed white lines mean you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: On a two-lane road, you may pass another vehicle on the right:

options.text: When driving on a single-lane entrance ramp.
When the driver ahead is going slower than the speed limit.
When the driver ahead is turning left.

questions.correctAnswerText: When the driver ahead is turning left.
questions.explanation: You can pass on the right when the driver ahead is making or signaling a left turn, as long as you stay on the shoulder. You can also pass on the right on roads with two or more marked lanes in each direction.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign appears at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street:

options.text: Turn your wheels to the right.
Turn your wheels to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels to the right.
questions.explanation: When parking on a downhill slope, turn your wheels toward the side of the road. If your vehicle rolls, it will roll away from traffic.

questions.question: When making a right turn on a green light, you must:
questions.explanation: You can turn right or left at a green light unless a sign says otherwise. When turning, you must let other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection go first.

questions.question: A fire engine is following your vehicle on a two-lane street, but it is not using emergency lights or sirens. You should:

options.text: Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move right, and stop.

questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is following you without its siren or lights on, you do not need to move. Drive normally.

questions.question: The most important thing about driving safely through curves is that you must:

options.text: Drive at the speed limit when entering the curve, then slow down at the sharpest part.
Slow down before entering the curve.
Speed up a little before entering the curve.
Drive at the speed limit before, during, and after the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before entering the curve.
questions.explanation: Slow down before entering a curve. Your vehicle's momentum can make it hard to turn. Slowing down first helps you stay in control.

questions.question: Is parental consent needed for breath, blood, and urine tests?

options.text: Yes, for people under 16 years old.

questions.explanation: If you are underage and arrested for testing, parental consent is not needed. However, the police will notify your parents of the arrest.

questions.question: Roads are most slippery:

options.text: After it has been raining for an hour or more.
During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of a rainstorm. Rain brings oil from the asphalt to the surface. Hot weather makes this worse.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will have text to confirm it is a no passing zone.

questions.question: What lights should you use when driving in fog?

options.text: It does not matter which lights you use.

questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: Which is a penalty for driving under the influence of alcohol?

options.text: Required attendance at an Alcohol Highway Safety School.

questions.correctAnswerText: Required attendance at an Alcohol Highway Safety School.
questions.explanation: For a first or second offense, you must attend an Alcohol Highway Safety School. This is required in addition to other penalties.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: The blind spot around a large vehicle.
An area for motor vehicles only.

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot around a large vehicle.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are the large blind spots around trucks and large vehicles. Stay out of these areas when possible.

questions.question: What blood alcohol concentration (BAC) is illegal for drivers 21 and older?
questions.explanation: For drivers 21 and older, driving with a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: The traffic light turns yellow as you approach an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely.
Speed up to get through before the light turns red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely.
questions.explanation: When the light turns yellow, slow down and stop before entering the intersection if it is safe. If you cannot stop safely, go through carefully.

questions.question: When driving where children are playing, what should you expect?

options.text: They know when it is safe to cross the street.
They will stop at the curb before crossing.
They may run in front of you without looking.
They will not cross unless an adult is with them.

questions.correctAnswerText: They may run in front of you without looking.
questions.explanation: Slow down and be extra careful when children are nearby. They may not understand danger and could run out in front of your vehicle without looking.

questions.question: When do roads freeze most quickly?
questions.explanation: In cold or wet weather, shaded areas freeze faster than other parts of the road. These areas also take longer to dry.
